title: Habit reflection
idea: Habit reflection: A short dated reflection follows a truthful activity record
audience: People who need to reflect within a mobile surface.
worksWellWhen: Learning matters more than streak pressure
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic editorial layout through its reflect priority and explicit commitment contract: Missing days are not silently filled
navigation: Habit reflection keeps the current reflect context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: A short dated reflection follows a truthful activity record
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to reflect; learning matters more than streak pressure
composition.priority: Missing days are not silently filled

imagery.role: Support the actual reflect context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Allow long answers and keyboard-safe save controls
Respect safe areas, native text scaling, keyboard intrusion and platform back behavior.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the habit reflection structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no reflect content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Missing days are not silently filled
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized reflect content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Missing days are not silently filled
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active reflect context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure on target devices; test interrupted/resumed state and low-memory restoration.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
